scope: Controlled Qwen3.5-4B INT8 preparation with deferred weight realization; original errno14 captured and kernel IOVA allocation failure recorded. No inference or benchmark trials.

ledger_at_failure.scope: Wrapped userspace create/destroy calls only; not physical RAM, kernel allocations or an IOVA exhaustion diagnosis.

[Sat Oct 24 18:08:46 2026] RKNPU fdab0000.npu: RKNPU: rknpu_gem_get_pages: dma map 20971520 fail
kernel_IOVA_evidence.supported_conclusion: This controlled MEM_CREATE failure is an IOVA allocation failure reported by the running kernel. Extents between tracked ranges may be reserved/cached/otherwise untracked; their origin is not proven.

compatible_upstream_mechanism.summary: The inspected Rockchip path converts DMA map failure to EFAULT. Its limited-alignment path calls direct IOVA allocation; the default path uses the generic DMA mapper. Linux alloc_iova_fast can drain cached IOVA ranges after allocation failure. This motivates a bounded default-alignment fallback experiment; it is not yet a demonstrated fix.
